newsitem.title: USA: Prudential Insurance unit files $750 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Prudential Insurance unit files $750 mln shelf.

text.p: Prudential Securities Secured Financing Corp, a unit of Prudential Insurance Co of America said Thursday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Comission to sell up to $750 million in pass-through certificates.
When combined with previous registrations, Prudential will have a total offering of $913,094,549 in certificates, the filing said.
The company will use the proceeds to buy mortgage loans or contracts represented by the certificates or such series, the filing said.
Prudential Securities Secured Financing is a subsidiary of Prudential Securities Group Inc which is a unit of Prudential Insurance Co of America.
